sentences.en: When you are driving, you should make way for ambulances.
sentences.zh: 当你开车的时候，应该为救护车让路。

sentences.en: The ambulance broke down in the middle of the avenue.
sentences.zh: 救护车在大街中间抛锚了。

sentences.en: I need to use your phone to call an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 我需要借用你的电话叫辆救护车。

senses.zh: [车辆][医] 救护车；战时流动医院
